extracted.name: Blueberry Cookies
extracted.description: Best blueberry cookies, in my opinion 😋
ingredient_lines: 1/3 cup soy milk (any milk of your liking)
instruction_lines: The dough will be very sticky and will stick to your hands even if you grease them. That is okay! Separate the dough into even weighed balls and flatten.
Dice up the butter and Add wet mixture, mix it all together and then add the blueberries.
Make the disks and set in the oven for 30 minutes or until fork comes out clean.
